name: plate-58-phone-stand
version_tag: BENCH TOOL, SOLO — Ron: 'Can you make me a cell phone holder that can hold my phone so it can video the perpetual calendar modules while I operate them?' 180_bench_phone_stand: two-slot camera stand, slot A 20deg recline (low oblique close-ups of the mesh, lens ~55-60mm up), slot B 50deg recline (looking down onto the board, ~45mm). Slot width 15.0 — sized for Ron's iPhone 15 Pro Max in an OtterBox Symmetry Clear (~12.5-13 cased, ~2mm insertion play; the 13.0 first cut would have been a press fit — Ron asked before it printed); middle third of each front lip cut away for thumb/cable; rear toe to -52 so a reclined phone cannot tip it while the bench shakes. Prints flat by construction (one extruded cross-section, every layer identical, zero overhang) — the #171 lesson applied at design time. Landscape phone, long edge in the slot. NOT a calendar part: no fit-critical dimensions, any infill >=12 percent, cosmetics irrelevant. 8 gates PASS. 0.4 nozzle as everything current (a fine first 0.6 candidate later, after that nozzle's coupon). | QUIET.
